full_page.content:
c. 1942
The following is a faithful transcription of the various Autographs written by the Servant of God, Father Solanus Casey, O.F.M.Cap., in books of the "Mystical City of God."
The Real Life of the Blessed Virgin Mother of God.
Don't read it before first asking the Holy Ghost to enlighten your mind and guide our poor Hearts.
Glory be to God!
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Book in possession of: Mrs. Elvera Clair 34492 W. Nine Mile Rd. Farmington Hills, MI. 48024
Glory be to God for having coached this work - the writing of the Life of our Bles'd Mother Mary, which means nothing less than the autobiography of Mary Immaculate Mother of God.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
To read it without praying to the Holy Ghost first for enlighten- ment and guidance is a mistake - to say the least.
Book in possession of: Mrs. Julia Janik 7246 Emerson St. Washington, MI. 48094
Dear Reader :-
"To know is to appreciate." How is it that we so little appreciate heavenly things? How is it that honor the President's Mother - and not the Mother of Jesus?
The following pages give you a practical introduction to Heaven's greatest jem - its Queen, the Virgin Mother of Jesus.
Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
God Bless you Reader Fr. Sol. Book in possession of: Mrs. Rita Calice 6218 Argyle Dearborn, MI. 48126
